FieldNotes.Comments: 't' array with 0 degrees rotation. Site installed in a field with dense brush and small trees surrounded by forested area. Soil clay rich and moist. Site center unburied due to water table 1ft deep after dry spell. North line 36m, south line 54m due to extremely thorny brush unsafe to pass through. Lines conduited, no russian bags. Signs of deer and hogs, hunting season has ended. Site next to ATV
